text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sapporo Kinen—and Air
Groove's
chance at a comeback—has
arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув, the Empress, steps onto the
track to
give a performance that meets
the expectations
and hopes of her fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
